# std.tuple

Tuples `(a, b)`, as `Tuple1` to `Tuple12`: compared field by field, cloned deeply, and a product domain when every part is a domain. Core re-exports them, so no module imports them.

Import: `use std.tuple.{...}`.

## `struct Tuple1<A>`

A tuple of one value, field `_0`.

## `struct Tuple2<A, B>`

A tuple of two values, `(a, b)`, fields `_0` and `_1`.

## `struct Tuple3<A, B, C>`

A tuple of three values, `(a, b, c)`, fields `_0` to `_2`.

## `struct Tuple4<A, B, C, E>`

A tuple of 4 values, fields `_0` to `_3`.

## `struct Tuple5<A, B, C, E, F>`

A tuple of 5 values, fields `_0` to `_4`.
